desc:
⚡ Open packs, unlock superpowers, and take down the Dominus bosses! ⚡

Rip open ability packs to collect powers: lightning, fire, frost, gravity, time, shadow, gold and more. Every card comes with its own set of moves. Level a card up to unlock its most powerful ability.

👊 FIGHT through the zones and smash enemies with your powers. The world breaks apart around you as you fight.
👑 DEFEAT BOSSES to open the next area, crack open their loot chests, and carry their packs home.
💰 BUILD YOUR BASE by putting your cards on holders so they earn cash for you, even while you’re fighting.
📈 GET STRONGER with upgrades, trails and auras that boost your Power, Health and speed.
🔥 CHAIN KILL STREAKS for bonus multipliers and critical hits.
📖 COMPLETE THE INDEX to earn permanent rewards for every rarity you collect.
🏆 CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS for Top Cash and Top Power.

Can you pull an Ancient card and beat Dominus Empyreus, the final boss?

👍 Like and join the group for a FREE Legend Pack!
